interface.shortDescription: Create multi-agent skills from the architecture guidelines.
interface.longDescription: Source of truth for multi-agent skill creation: building skills that orchestrate one or more agents, following the skills/agents architecture copied from synaptic-canvas. Provides access to a curated reference library: the v0.7 architecture guidelines, the D1-D5 dependency model, and a dated harness-capability matrix so no skill ever hardcodes a stale harness assumption.
defaultPrompt: Use skill-forge to create a multi-agent skill following the architecture guidelines.
